title: Merge Intervals
statement: Given an array of intervals where intervals[i] = [start_i, end_i], merge all overlapping intervals.
Return an array of the non-overlapping intervals that cover all the intervals in the input, sorted by start.

examples.explanation: [1,3] and [2,6] overlap, so they merge into [1,6].
